entities.name: Numa
entities.description: An elf of Zendikar and clan chief of the Joraga Nation who exiled the young Nissa Revane.

entities.name: Joraga Nation
entities.description: Elven nation of Zendikar led by Numa's clan, destroyed by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Harsh, dangerous plane where Numa lived.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker, as a youth an animist plagued by dreams, exiled by Numa.

entities.name: Meroe
entities.description: Nissa's mother, one of the last animists.

entities.name: Animists
entities.description: Group who Numa said angered Zendikar and paid the price.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's upheaval, implied to have killed the animists.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Region destroyed by the Eldrazi along with the Joraga Nation.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Beings that destroyed Bala Ged and the Joraga Nation.

events.summary: Numa decides to exile the young Nissa Revane to protect the clan.
events.quote: Numa made the hard decision to exile a young Nissa Revane

events.summary: Nissa, believing Numa right, slips out of her home with her staff-sword and bow before her mother notices.
events.quote: Nissa packed her staff-sword and bow and slipped out of the house before her mother could notice.

events.summary: The Eldrazi destroy Bala Ged and the Joraga Nation, making Numa's survival unlikely.
events.quote: Bala Ged and the Joraga Nation were destroyed by the Eldrazi

relations.quote: Numa was an Elf from Zendikar , and a clan chief of the Joraga Nation .
She and her mother Meroe were the last animists
